summary: Drop expressive fruit, combine matching pairs, and manage the pile without crossing the danger line.
rules: Drop fruit into a bounded container. Equal fruit merge into the next original level and award score. Two maximum-level melons disappear for a bonus. A fruit continuously above the danger line for 1.5 seconds ends the run.

controls.input: Tap anywhere in the game viewport
Drag anywhere in the game viewport, then release
controls.action: Choose the horizontal position and drop
Apply bounded impulses to the settled pile

sessionFlow: Show the persisted two-step tutorial on first launch
Navigate to the Decompose result screen after sustained overflow

accessibility.announcements: Expose the changing score, body count, danger state, clear instruction, and result through semantics.
accessibility.focus: Preserve pane identity across adaptive rearrangement and keep every action in the supporting scroll path.
accessibility.labels: Label the board summary, next fruit, action counts, advertising actions, loading state, and result controls.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Disable optional blinking, targeting pulses, tutorial gesture loops, completion particles, and ambient result motion while retaining deterministic gameplay physics.

visualStyle.description: Original warm orchard palette with matte vector fruit, highlights, leaves, blush, and expressive faces.

audioStyle.description: Original 84 BPM procedural fruit-crate groove with wooden knocks, rolling textures, glass accents, and deterministic event SFX.

storage.resetBehavior: All values are removed by the host-owned MiniApp namespace reset.

evidence: All code and Canvas art are original to this repository; only genre-level rules were referenced.

code: Original Kotlin and Compose implementation in :game:fruitmerge
art: Original runtime Canvas primitives and original vector icon
audio: Original immutable procedural declarations rendered through the public MiniApp audio API; no recorded assets

acceptanceScenarios.name: Merge
acceptanceScenarios.then: They become one next-level fruit and score increases once

acceptanceScenarios.name: Overflow grace
acceptanceScenarios.given: A fruit briefly crosses the danger line

acceptanceScenarios.name: Clear gate
acceptanceScenarios.then: The ad gate completes before one target opportunity

acceptanceScenarios.name: Shake gate
acceptanceScenarios.then: The ad gate completes before one bounded shake

acceptanceScenarios.name: Drop pacing
acceptanceScenarios.when: Another drop is requested within 450 ms of fixed simulation time
acceptanceScenarios.then: The second drop is rejected without consuming or spawning a fruit

acceptanceScenarios.name: First-launch tutorial
acceptanceScenarios.given: Tutorial state has not been persisted
acceptanceScenarios.when: One accepted tap drop and one accepted drag drop are completed
acceptanceScenarios.then: The overlay disappears and tutorial_seen is persisted

knownLimitations: Procedural synthesis only; no user-selectable music tracks
